description: Updates an existing Cognigy.AI handover provider. Use this to rename it or change its properties. MUTATING: Set dryRun=false to update.

dryRun.description: If true (default), validates without updating. Set to false to actually update.

projectId.description: The project ID the handover provider belongs to

properties.description: Provider properties to set, as key/value pairs (see get_handover_provider for the current keys). Keys not listed are kept.

providerId.description: The handover provider ID to update

name: update_handover_provider
